title: Jeffershizzle archive modernization & styling tuning
content:
Jeffershizzle completed a major modernization and visual refinement pass to faithfully reproduce the original photography archive aesthetic within a modern Vite-powered SPA.

Highlights:

  • Vite Integration & ES Modules: Converted the project to an npm/Vite architecture with ES module exports, unified dev/prod Cloudflare Tunnel image API routing, and lightning-fast sub-second builds.
  • Archive Typography & Spacing: Recreated the signature legacy layout with Source Serif 4 (500 weight), tight negative tracking, zero vertical gaps against 44px fixed header/footer banners, and an exact 2px photo grid gap across all gallery formations.
  • Browse Navigation Tuning: Added an archive header ("this is an archive, modernized with artificial intelligence, slightly imperfect."), enlarged category typography (+4pt to 25px), anchored category titles to the right, and added a dedicated left-aligned "back." link when browsing galleries with unlinked photo views.
  • Asset & Landing Management: Safely archived landing background #78 into _archived/, configured dynamic active-list selection across 91 landing images, and updated the site favicon and bookmark preview from the server asset repository.
